description: Read one of your skills: its details and file list, or with path the text of one file (at most 200000 characters, with truncated set when it was cut). Pass version to inspect an older version or a pending update. Only your own skills. Requires signing in (skills:read).

path.description: A file path from the file list, such as SKILL.md. Returns that file as text instead of only the list

version.description: A version number to inspect, such as the pendingVersion of a skill; default the current version

name: get_skill
title: Read a skill
